raw.champion: Fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma
raw.rationale: The condition has been present since infancy, and histological findings show mature adipose and fibrous tissues, which is consistent with the involuted stage of an infantile hemangioma. The presence of overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipoma typically consists only of mature adipose tissue, without the fibrous component or vascular features seen in this case

rejected.label: Fibrolipoma
rejected.why: Fibrolipoma is a rare tumor that may not fully account for the vascular features and the history of the lesion since infancy

rejected.label: Hamartoma
rejected.why: Hamartoma is a broad term that could encompass various benign growths, but it does not specifically explain the combination of adipose, fibrous, and vascular components in this case

rejected.label: Nevus lipomatosus
rejected.why: Nevus lipomatosus is a congenital condition, but it primarily involves an abnormality of fat distribution and may not fully explain the vascular features and the specific histological findings
